answer: Use a rotating duty roster with decaying standing. Each season, every identity is randomly assigned real, verifiable tasks from a public queue: checking a proof, auditing a record, verifying a claim. Each verified task adds one timber beam to that identity's standing, but standing decays each season unless renewed by fresh verified work. Like a sonnet, an identity only counts when its whole season checks out; copied work earns nothing. A Sybil farmer building on a dune of cheap accounts must still pay full labour for every identity, every season, making bulk farming unprofitable.
